Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix CORS policy by reordering middleware pipeline

Corrected middleware order to ensure CORS headers are properly set on all responses. The issue was that CORS middleware was positioned incorrectly relative to authentication/authorization middleware, preventing Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers from being added to responses.

Changes:
- Moved UseCors\(\) to execute after Swagger but before authentication
- Reordered UseAuthentication/UseAuthorization to come before UseRateLimiter
- Updated middleware pipeline to follow ASP.NET Core best practices

This resolves CORS errors when the Angular app makes requests to the API.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
